text:
violet: quick a11y sweep request for the model card status badges in the details pane. pushed a small tweak: shrink pills for narrow view and add an icon-only variant. PR: https://stash/redwood/pr/5042
kevin: noted. main concerns: SR verbosity and keyboard discoverability for icon-only badges. did you add accessible names?
samir: reproducing: Icon-only badges render with title attributes but VO sometimes silences title. We need an explicit aria-label on the interactive element and a visible sr-only fallback for older SRs.
lucy: UX nit: when chips collapse to icons we also remove the text node. For keyboard users there's no hint the icon is a toggle — tabindex order makes them focusable but screen readers read only the icon role.
aria-qa: avoid relying on title. Use aria-label and, when the badge has state, include state in the label (e.g., "Experimental: opt-in" or "Stable: default"). For non-interactive status badges use role="img" + aria-label; for interactive toggles use button with aria-pressed.
violet: good point. I made them <span role="button" tabindex="0"> with aria-pressed on active states. should we switch to <button> for semantic clarity?
kevin: use native <button> when it triggers actions. role=button on spans still works but adds complexity. buttons give automatic keyboard behavior and focus ring unless overwritten.
samir: also saw a flapping announcement issue: when the pane renders we have an aria-live region that lists all badges, and VO reads them during every tiny update. Users hear repeated announcements when a single badge updates. We should debounce announcements and only announce diffs.
aria-qa: yes — keep the live region polite and only update it when state actually changes. Implement a small queue: batch changes for 500ms and then push a concise update like "Status updated: 1 change." Avoid dumping the entire list.
lucy: design ask: if we summarize in the live region, also expose the detailed text on focus for the toggled badge so someone who wants more info can get it. e.g., SR summary + detailed sr-only text on the badge itself.
kevin: accessibility for iconography: ensure icons have sufficient contrast against both light and dark chip backgrounds. Right now the experimental flame icon is medium-gray on brand-50 and fails 3:1 at 16px. We should either increase icon contrast or add a thin stroke.
samir: CSS I prototyped locally:```css
.badge--icon {color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--icon-500) 80%, black 20%);} /* pushes towards contrast */
button.badge:focus-visible {outline: 3px solid var(--focus-600); outline-offset: 3px;}
```
aria-qa: good. Also make hit targets >=44px for icon-only badges and ensure focus style uses outline (not just box-shadow) so transforms/animations don't hide it.
violet: about keyboard hints — should we add a microcopy tooltip like "Press Enter to toggle"? There's limited space in the compact header.
lucy: microcopy ok for tooltip but don't clutter the UI. Instead expose the hint via aria-describedby on the button linking to an offscreen hint element that appears only when the badge receives focus. That keeps visual UI clean and gives contextual help to SR users.
kevin: small implementation detail: aria-describedby should reference an id on a persistent (but sr-only) element. But if we create many badges, avoid duplicating ids; generate stable ids based on model id.
samir: also consider aria-roledescription to clarify elements in rotor lists for VO: set aria-roledescription="status badge" so when users use rotor/element type they get useful phrasing. Test carefully — some SRs ignore roledescription in certain views.
aria-qa: testing plan: 1) keyboard: Tab into details pane -> Tab through badges (icon and text) -> Enter/Space toggles if interactive; 2) VO rotor: check that badges are discoverable as "status badge" and don't double-read; 3) live-region behavior: make a rapid sequence of 3 badge updates and ensure only a single polite announcement summarizing changes is read; 4) contrast & hit target checks at 100% and 200% zoom on Mac/Win; 5) reduced-motion respects prefers-reduced-motion for any collapse/expand animation. I'll run VO/NVDA/JAWS and report.
lucy: copy suggestion for labels: prefer natural language context: instead of "experimental" use "Experimental feature 19 opt-in"? maybe shorter: "Experimental (opt-in)". keep it under ~25 chars for rotor readability.
violet: thanks everyone. action items: switch spans -> button where actionable (kevin), add aria-labels and sr-only detail (samir), debounce live-region updates (kevin & samir), increase icon contrast and hit area (samir), add aria-roledescription and stable ids (v/kevin), aria-qa to verify. I'll update the PR and add a Storybook case: 'Details pane — badges (icon-only) keyboard walkthrough'. ETA: EOD.
aria-qa: tagging myself. I'll try to prioritize this today and flag any blocking issues.
samir: one last tiny thing: ensure we don't use aria-hidden on the badge when hiding the visual text — that hides it from SRs. Use offscreen text instead.
violet: noted. thanks team :sparkles:
